name: HYDRA-UMC-BRIDGE-DROIDS
notes: Real, dependency-free coordination boundary for legged/humanoid droids: validates a small named action-trigger vocabulary (WALK_TO/PICK_OBJECT/PLACE_OBJECT/RETURN_HOME/HOLD_POSITION) and its real required parameters before forwarding through HYDRA-UMC-SDK's shared safety gate. Never computes gait/balance/joint trajectories itself - that authority stays with the droid's own onboard controller. No real Wi-Fi/BT/4G-5G transport adapter or physical droid validated yet.
